component.name: BrowserOS neo
component.summary: Chromium browser for web agents and browser automation

description.p: BrowserOS neo is a Chromium-based browser for web agents. It includes a local agent server and browser extensions for automating tasks in web pages.

This community package downloads the official Linux Debian release unmodified at install time. Browser updates arrive through Flatpak; the bundled agent server and extensions retain their upstream update mechanisms. Profiles and agent data are kept in the app's private storage.

Downloads are accessible directly. Other files can be selected through the desktop file chooser. Importing a native browser profile requires an optional read-only grant, for example: flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/.config/google-chrome:ro com.browseros.BrowserOS. Undo optional grants with: flatpak override --user --reset com.browseros.BrowserOS.
